title: Which license a container job will use, decided before Gurobi starts
heading: A Container Gets Its License at Run Time, Never in the Image
cases: all three WLS variables give ('wls', params) with the license id as an int
GRB_LICENSE_FILE naming an existing file gives ('file', that path)
GRB_LICENSE_FILE naming a missing file gives an error even when a default file exists
without the variable, /opt/gurobi/gurobi.lic is chosen before the home directory's file
one or two WLS variables give an error that names the missing ones and no value
